_about: Inputs of scripts/canopy_day.py. Every number carries its source and tag: [D] read by the main session, [D-ag] read by a subagent (note file named), [Y] our assumption (swept in the study). Edit here, not in the script.

stuck_active_per_h.source: dangerous rate; exida FMEDA report P+F 03/11-10 R015 v1 r1.1 (2004) Table 2 p.3: inductive NAMUR sensor NJ 5-30GK-S1N 15.4 FIT safe / 9.63 FIT dangerous, SN 29500 basis [D, read by main session]; x18 = MIL-HDBK-217F N2 switch pi_E AIF/GB (p.14-2) [D-ag, R4_sensor_failure_rates.md] as an airborne-environment factor [Y]

stuck_inactive_per_h.source: half of the safe rate (split [Y]); exida FMEDA report P+F 03/11-10 R015 v1 r1.1 (2004) Table 2 p.3: inductive NAMUR sensor NJ 5-30GK-S1N 15.4 FIT safe / 9.63 FIT dangerous, SN 29500 basis [D, read by main session]; x18 = MIL-HDBK-217F N2 switch pi_E AIF/GB (p.14-2) [D-ag, R4_sensor_failure_rates.md] as an airborne-environment factor [Y]

open_per_h.source: other half of the safe rate: output < 1.2 mA = detected by the line-monitoring input; exida FMEDA report P+F 03/11-10 R015 v1 r1.1 (2004) Table 2 p.3: inductive NAMUR sensor NJ 5-30GK-S1N 15.4 FIT safe / 9.63 FIT dangerous, SN 29500 basis [D, read by main session]; x18 = MIL-HDBK-217F N2 switch pi_E AIF/GB (p.14-2) [D-ag, R4_sensor_failure_rates.md] as an airborne-environment factor [Y]

short_per_h.source: included in the safe/dangerous totals above

flight_h.source: G-MIIL accident flight 1037-1058 UTC = 0.35 h (AAIB p. 5); 1 h taken as a round typical sortie

latent_interval_h.source: functional check at the 100 h / annual inspection (ICA proposal); the open-canopy plausibility check usually finds a stuck bolt sensor much sooner

trip_mm.source: chosen inside the trip window computed in this study (C2)

sigma_trip_mm.source: rigging + wear + switch differential; to be measured at the bench test (step 8)

sigma_full_mm.source: scatter of the fully-locked handle position; to be measured

hazard_below_mm.source: bolts < 70 % of the 60->70 mm travel counted as hazardous; AAIB gives only the two end states 60/70 mm (p. 9)

p_misrig_common.source: per flight: all bolt sensors set up wrong together (wrong gauge, bracket set-up error), latent until the next functional check; no data, swept

misrig_shift_mm.source: trip point 5 mm early = halfway between partial (60) and full (70) lock: partial locks read LOCKED

partial.source: per flight = omission of the step 'pull aft handle fully rearward': NUREG/CR-1278 Table 20-7 per-item omission HEP 0.001 (short list, checkoff used) ... 0.01 (long list, no checkoff), 0.05 (procedure not used) [D, R0_NUREG_CR-1278_omission_HEPs.md]; central 1e-3, swept 1e-4..5e-2

one_bolt.source: per flight; SP-HMM loose rear fitting (AAIB p. 23) shows it exists; rate unknown

partial.source: AAIB p. 20: no observable visual difference at the frame; only the handle position (green marking, POH rev. 1.11) shows it

one_bolt.source: bolts hidden from view (AAIB p. 10); handle may still be at the end stop

unseated.source: an unseated canopy is visible and noisy

p_nuisance.source: per flight, nuisance alerts outside the channel model (intermittent connector, contamination, sensor knocked late); AC 25.1322-1 App. 5 separates false and nuisance alerts [D-ag, R4]; value no data, swept in C3

rate_sets._about: Sensitivity: same study with other per-channel rates (A3 only).

stuck_active_per_h.source: MIL-HDBK-217F N2 sec. 14.1 snap-action lambda_b 0.49e-6/h x pi_E AIF 18 x pi_Q 1 (pi_L, pi_C = 1 assumed); 50/50 mode split [Y]

open_per_h.source: as above, 25 % (wire/contact open, detected by SPDT complementary coding)

stuck_active_per_h.source: MIL-HDBK-217F N2 sec. 14.1 limit switch lambda_b 4.3e-6/h x pi_E AIF 18; 50/50 split [Y]

targets._about: AC 23.1309-1E Fig. 2 p.23, Class I, per flight hour [D-ag, R4]: probability ceilings by failure-condition class

plus_misrig_factor.source: LOCK-SENSE Plus: an independent analog channel learns the full-lock position every flight and flags disagreement with the switching channel, so a common gauge error must also fool the self-calibration; factor is our assumption, swept qualitatively

powerlock_partial_factor.source: Powered over-centre lock: the omission 'handle not pulled fully aft' (NUREG/CR-1278 0.001/step) is replaced by actuator failure to complete the stroke; factor is our assumption

partial.source: jury question Q2: after many flights of 'green', pilots stop pulling to the end stop; Dismukes & Berman 2010 found 14 % of checklist deviations caught [D-ag]; value is our assumption

unseated.source: an unseated canopy stays visible and noisy
